tasks.subject: Task 1: Stats endpoint summary figures
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET /api/decks/:id/stats returns a summary object with card count, unseen count, mock and practice accuracy with their review counts, and the deck's last answered timestamp.

**Files:**
- Create: `backend/src/stats.rs`
- Create: `backend/tests/stats.rs`
- Modify: `backend/src/lib.rs` (module list)
- Modify: `backend/src/routes/decks.rs` (router at lines 66-70, plus the new handler)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GET /api/decks/:id/stats returns 200 with a summary object and a cards array (empty until Task 2)
- [ ] card_count and unseen_count count only non-archived cards
- [ ] mock_accuracy and practice_accuracy are computed from their own mode's reviews only
- [ ] Both accuracies are null - not 0 - when that mode has no reviews
- [ ] An overridden review counts as correct
- [ ] last_answered_at is null for a deck with no reviews
- [ ] An unknown deck id returns 404 with the standard error envelope
- [ ] accuracy_of has a Rust unit test proving the zero-review case returns None and not Some(NaN)

**Verify:** `cargo test --test stats && cargo test --lib stats` -> all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/src/stats.rs", "backend/src/lib.rs", "backend/src/routes/decks.rs", "backend/tests/stats.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --test stats && cargo test --lib stats", "acceptanceCriteria": ["summary endpoint returns 200", "archived cards excluded from counts", "mode-separated accuracy", "null not zero for absent modes", "overridden counts as correct", "404 on unknown deck", "accuracy_of unit-tested for None vs NaN"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Per-card miss rates
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The cards array carries one entry per answered card - card_id, attempt_count, and a recency-weighted miss_rate computed by practice.rs's existing weighted_miss_rate.

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/src/stats.rs` (add load_card_stats, fill in deck_stats)
- Modify: `backend/tests/stats.rs` (add four tests)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each answered, non-archived card appears once in cards with its attempt count
- [ ] Cards with no reviews are omitted from cards entirely
- [ ] Archived cards are omitted from cards even when they have reviews
- [ ] miss_rate is recency-weighted: of two cards with identical raw accuracy, the one whose misses are more recent ranks higher
- [ ] Only the last RECENT_REVIEW_LIMIT (10) reviews of a card feed its miss rate

**Verify:** `cargo test --test stats` -> all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/src/stats.rs", "backend/tests/stats.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --test stats", "acceptanceCriteria": ["answered cards appear once with attempt count", "unreviewed cards omitted", "archived cards omitted", "miss rate is recency-weighted", "only last 10 reviews feed the miss rate"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: The formatters
tasks.description:
**Goal:** formatPercentage and formatRelativeTime exist in frontend/src/lib/format.ts, with formatRelativeTime correctly parsing the app's Z-suffixed ISO timestamps.

**Files:**
- Modify: `frontend/src/lib/format.ts`
- Create: `frontend/src/lib/format.test.ts` - only if a test runner is already configured; check frontend/package.json for a test script first

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] formatPercentage(0.714) -> '71%'; formatPercentage(null) -> em dash
- [ ] formatRelativeTime returns 'just now', 'N minutes ago', 'N hours ago', 'N days ago', and falls back to a date beyond 30 days
- [ ] formatRelativeTime takes the reference time as a parameter, defaulting to Date.now(), so it is testable without mocking the clock

**Verify:** `cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm exec oxlint`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["frontend/src/lib/format.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm exec oxlint", "acceptanceCriteria": ["formatPercentage rounds and renders an em dash for null", "formatRelativeTime covers all bands plus a date fallback", "reference time is a parameter"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: The summary strip
tasks.description:
**Goal:** /decks/:id renders a stats strip under the three mode buttons, and fails quietly.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/components/deck/DeckStatsStrip.tsx`
- Modify: `frontend/src/pages/DeckPage.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The strip renders coverage, mock accuracy, practice accuracy and last-studied, separated by middots
- [ ] A mode with no reviews renders an em dash, never 0%
- [ ] A deck with no reviews at all renders the single line 'No sessions yet.' instead of a strip of dashes
- [ ] A failed stats request leaves the page rendering exactly as before, with no toast
- [ ] The fetch is aborted on unmount and re-runs when the deck id changes

**Verify:** `cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm build && pnpm exec oxlint`, then load a deck in the browser

```json:metadata
{"files": ["frontend/src/components/deck/DeckStatsStrip.tsx", "frontend/src/pages/DeckPage.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm build && pnpm exec oxlint", "acceptanceCriteria": ["strip renders all four figures", "em dash not 0% for an absent mode", "'No sessions yet.' for an unstudied deck", "failure produces no toast and no strip", "fetch aborts on unmount"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: The per-card weakness badge
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Each CardRow carries a badge showing either its recency-weighted miss rate or that the card is unseen.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/components/deck/CardStatBadge.tsx`
- Modify: `frontend/src/components/deck/CardRow.tsx`
- Modify: `frontend/src/pages/DeckPage.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A card with reviews shows '42% missed - 6'
- [ ] At or above a 40% miss rate the badge is the solid destructive pair; below it, secondary
- [ ] A card absent from cards shows an Unseen badge
- [ ] An archived card shows no stats badge in either state
- [ ] When stats have not loaded (or failed) no badge renders at all
- [ ] frontend/scripts/check-contrast.py still passes - the badge introduces no new colour pair

**Verify:** `cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm build && pnpm exec oxlint && cd .. && python3 frontend/scripts/check-contrast.py`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["frontend/src/components/deck/CardStatBadge.tsx", "frontend/src/components/deck/CardRow.tsx", "frontend/src/pages/DeckPage.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm build && pnpm exec oxlint && cd .. && python3 frontend/scripts/check-contrast.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["miss-rate badge text", "solid destructive above the 40% threshold", "Unseen badge for unreviewed cards", "no badge on archived rows", "no badge when stats absent", "contrast script still passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
